balls.text: shorter one from Morkel, played it away to mid-off for a single. Only 56 runs from the last nine overs, for the loss of six wickets!

out, run-out! Poor running from Mishra there, that was an easy two. Short from Morkel, cut away but loops in the air, it was away from the fielder and should have been two. The batsman was busy looking at whether the fielder was going to catch it and he missed coming back quickly for the second. Woefully short of the crease.
on his pads, pitched right up and flicked away to the deep square-leg boundary. That seemed like it was going into the boundary but Taylor did well to run across and save a couple.
slower, shorter, Mishra almost was waiting for a quick bouncer and he was woefully short of getting any bat to the ball.
full-toss and he has bludgeoned it to long-on for a single.
drilled down to the mid-off fielder who had enough time to have two shies at the stumps, but missed the non-striker's stumps, Mishra was nowhere close to the crease.
and he is back to conceding boundaries! Slower again but shorter too and he has been spanked over his own head for a four! 16 from that over brings parity back to the proceedings.
another slower one and that beats the bat yet again! He has strung together a couple of dots here.
slower one and this time he beats the bat.
full-toss and he has smacked it into the same region for a couple of bounces before it rolls away for a four.
shot, six! That is hit inside-out over the extra-cover region for a six! It was wide outside the off-stump and it was pitched right up, the batsman hit that gracefully
it was drifting on to his middle-stump and it was flicked away to the leg-side for a single.
outside the off-stump and left alone. Far too wide that one.
snorter! That rose from length and almost took Mishra along with it, tries to get his bat and body away, manages to get a bit of glove or something on the way and they are off for a single.
short of length and Steyn wanted to go over Sehwag at short cover, manages to only get it up to him and they are now seven down.
140 km/hr, down the leg-side, and flicked away to the square-leg region for a couple.
on the middle-stump and defended back to the bowler.
Edged and caught! Goes down the track and wanted to clear the long-off fielder, gets a thin edge through to the wicket-keeper. They wanted to check the no-ball, but it looks fine.
fuller but misdirected, down the leg-side and is left well-alone for the umpire to call it a wide.
just short of good length, on the middle-stump and that is pulled away to the leg-side for a single. They wanted a second but that is well-fielded.
shorter from the bowler and this time the bowler was going down the pitch, and cuts it away over the left of the point fielder, but right of third-man for a four.
slower one and that beats the batsman outside the off-stump yet again!
quicker one, outside the off-stump and the batsman, who was moving down the leg-side, misses it.
outside the off-stump, slower and the batsman tries to cut it away, the bottom-edge goes to the wicket-keeper, who immediately whips off his gloves and throws the stumps down.
short of length yet again and he goes on to the back-foot, dabs it to the third-man region for a single.
short from Umesh Yadav and Christian has unleashed a pull, does not get on the top of it, a bit of a top-edge and it goes into the hands of Nadeem again at deep square-leg.
well bowled yet again, angling into the bat and the batsman fails to get it anywhere. Excellent spell of bowling ends where he did not concede a single boundary!
tries to cut it away and gets an inside-edge that goes to ground and pops up into the collar-bone of the wicket-keeper.
outside the off-stump and it is driven through the covers for a couple of runs.
swept away from middle-stump to deep square-leg for a single.
a bit of a round-arm action, drifting down the leg-side, dabbed away to deep square-leg
goes down the pitch and is driven to long-on for a single
on the middle-stump and it is defended away to the leg-side for a single. Exactly eight an over.
on the off-stump, tapped it to the off-side and they are away for a quick single. Pathan tried to throw the stumps down but he failed to get is hand on to the ball.
slower one but Pathan misses the line there, down the leg-side and Chipli flicks it away to the fine-leg for a four.
short of length, tries to cut it away but misses the edge of the bat.
outside the off-stump and slower, tries to punch it through the covers, goes to the left of the point fielder.
outside the off-stump and driven by Christian to short covers.
short of length and played away to the off-side, no run.
On the back-foot and defended.

that is spooned away to the short mid-wicket fielder for a simple catch for Virender Sehwag! Duminy tried to play it to the leg-side and the slowness of the deliver seemed to have affected his stroke, got a bit of an edge and he has to go now.
down the wicket and played away to the leg-side for a single.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single
goes down the pitch and is smacked to long-on for a single
smacked away to long-off but only for a single. A much better over thanks to the loss of that wicket.
down the leg-side and it touches the pad through to the wicket-keeper.
on the middle-stump and Christian defends it back to the bowler.
short of length yet again and punched down the ground to long-on for a single.
on the middle, short of length and punched to the left of third-man for a couple.
on the middle, short of length and driven back to the bowler.

swept and out, caught! He was missed off the previous such stroke no such luck this time. Nadeem has his second wicket as Patel's sweep has been well caught at deep square-leg by the fielder, who judged it rather well at the fence. And no problems with the sun either.
on his pads and that is flicked away to the leg-side for a single
shorter one and he tries to pull it away, no power in the stroke.
drives it to long-on for a single.
Dropped! On the pads of Patel, who sweeps away to the leg-side and Pietersen should have caught it, he seems to have lost it in the sun and misses on getting the ball on the full!
driven to the leg-side for a single
short from Yadav and it hurries on to the batsman, he manages to swivel it away for a single.

that is caught at third-man but the umpires are consulting for the waist-height no-ball. And yes, that is easily above the waist-height of the diminutive Parthiv Patel! Sometimes it pays to not be too tall!
on the off-stump and driven off the back-foot for a single.
cut away off the back-foot, it was not too wide from the bowler and Christian was able to unleash the cut well!
short of length and he punches it to long-on for a single.
short and six! What a shot! He was going down the pitch and the bowler shortened his length and yet, the batsman smacks it over mid-wicket for a six!
on his pads and Christian drives it to the long-on for a single.
down the leg-side, missing his line yet again, a wide called.
short of length yet again, Christian goes on to is back-foot and plays it down to long-off for a single.
short again and punched down to long-off
shortish and he tries to cut it away, goes straight to the short cover fielder.
shorter and that is pulled away to the long-on region for a single
on the middle-stump, the batsman comes out on to the front foot but defended back.
first ball and he has a wicket! Straighter one from Nadeem and the batsman tried to go for the reverse sweep, he missed it and that one seemed to be crashing straight into the stumps.
short from Yadav, pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
another slower on the middle-stump and tapped away to the off-side for a single.
shorter and too close to the batsman to play a cut, he allows it to come on and dabs it to fine third-man.
good length, outside the off-stump and punched away to the deep point.
slower one, it was really slow but too wide outside the off-stump and he will need to re-bowl it.
width afforded to the batsman, short outside the off-stump and the outside edge to that cut goes to the third-man for a four!
flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single.
driven back to the bowler, who dives across to his left for a single
outside the off-stump and driven on the up for a single
punched it through the covers for a run. 10 already in the over.
what was that! That almost looked like he was beaten off the slower one but the batsman was still able to pull it straight through mid-off for a four!
pitched right up and driven to long-off for a single
poor, poor bowling, short ball and Patel is quickly on to it, pulls it away to the leg-side for a four. The fine-leg was up and that was the worst form of delivery he could have bowled.
tries to sweep it away, KP appeals in hope, wicket-keeper rushes across to the leg-side to prevent the single but the batsmen are through for a run. Nine from that over.
played away to the leg-side for a single.
down the pitch and he has gently scooped it over the bowler for a four! Excellent batting by the man in form!
down the leg-side yet again and there is an appeal, umpire does not call it a wide because it had come off the trousers. Good call.
short this time and Patel rocks back and pulls it away for a single
pitched up and hit inside-out over extra-cover for a single
down the leg-side and the batsman misses, called a wide.
slower one and that is played towards the covers for a single. Brings up the 50 at the end of the sixth over.
punched off the back-foot towards mid-off for a run.
short ball again, this time slower and it has been pulled away to the left of Umesh, who dives this time and saves a couple.
on his pads and Patel was almost walking into it, and then flicks it away to the right of Umesh Yadav at deep square-leg, mis-fields at the fence. Should have been not more than two.
slower ball, inside-edge but they rush off for a run.
Oh ho! What a welcome! That is almost a gentle loosener one thought and it has been pummelled into the leg-side fence for a six!
outside the off-stump and it is punched away to the mid-off region. Good shot for no run.
short of length and he wanted to play it away to the leg-side, gets a bit of an edge and the ball stops in front of the batsman, the non-striker calls him through for a run.
short again, and this has been absolutely smashed to the fine-leg fence. The man was at deep square-leg and there was no stopping that ball racing away to the fence.
on the middle-stump and Patel drives towards the mid-on fielder and they rush off for a quickly-taken run.
pitched up by Morkel and driven to the coves, misfielded and the batsmen are through for a single
Dhawan has been aggressive this season and he goes after Morkel, does not get in the middle and the ball lobs up over the bowler for a couple
third four in a row for Patel, outside the off-stump, pitched right up and the batsman throws his bat at it, goes to the point fence for a boundary. 14 from the over
short and shot! Pathan has been bowling very short to Patel and this time the batsman gets it in the meaty area of the bat and gets it to the right of the deep square-leg fielder for a four.
outside the off-stump, lot of width and Patel went for a cut, gets probably the toe of the bat and it races way to the third-man fence.
outside the off-stump and keeps a little low, beats the bottom-edge of the batsman through to the keeper.
outside the off-stump, moving away a little and cut away to the third-man fielder for a single.
short ball, probably even slower and he went for a full-bloodied pull, did not get it in the middle of the bat, falls short of the deep square-leg fielder.
tapped away to the off-side and they are off for a quick run. Three runs off the over and a wicket for Morkel.
on his pads and that is flicked away to the fine-leg fielders for a single.
big appeal from behind the wickets but the bowler seemed hardly interested. Outside the off-stump and he tried to cut it away , misses and it goes through to the wicket-keeper.
tries to cut it away to the point region but goes straight to the gully fielder.

top-edge and caught! That was on the middle-edge, Sanga was getting frustrated with all those hits to the fielders and he tried to half-pull, half-flick it away, only gets a leading edge and it soared high in the air before landing safely in the hands of the fielder. Well-caught by Nagar and Morkel has stuck immediately!
good length ball, outside the off-stump and driven to wide mid-off for a single, well fielded by KP, diving to his right.
Sanga also shimmies down the pitch and tries to clear the in-field but fails in that endeavour as the ball goes straight to mid-on.
goes down the pitch and tries to smack it, but gets an inside-edge to the ball, fast outfield almost takes it to the fine-leg fence. The batsmen get three.
short and this time it is pulled away into the gap, the fielder at square-leg dived but failed to get any hand to it. Goes for the first four of the innings.
goes down the pitch and drives it to the covers for another dot ball!
shorter and quicker and this time he tries to cut away, beats the outside edge of the bat.
pitched up, driven to point.
bends his knee and cuts the length ball through to third-man for a single. Both openers are off the mark now.
short ball and Sanga swivels and pulls it away. Would be a tad unhappy that it goes straight to fine-leg for only a single.
pulls back his length, but is outside the off-stump, Sanga tries to cut it away but goes to the point region.
further fuller and the captain drives Pathan straighter, to mid-off but is still not able to find the gap.
pitched a little up this time, Sangakkara is brought on to the front-foot, drives into the covers for nothing.
short of good length, almost a half-tracker and outside the off-stump and Sangakkara pulls it to mid-on.
short and KP has smacked the bowler back over his head for a flat-as-flat-can-be six to bring up his century. And yes, to win the game for his side!
nicked away, but goes on the bounce to the wicket-keeper, which means that KP sill has a chance to get his century.
pitched up o the bat and drilled by KP through the sweeper region for a single.
short and Nagar plays an ugly swipe, it goes to the long-off region for a single.
short ball from Steyn, KP was expecting it given the number of fielders on the leg-side, deep, he pulls it away to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
slower one and Nagar waits for it, before playing it to the third-man region for a single. Over to KP now.
pitched right up to the bat and Nagar gives himself some room and drills it through the covers for a couple of runs.
and driven yet again down to the long-off region for a single. Only eight needed from 12 balls.
dropped by Sangakkara I think, driven hard to short cover and the captain got his right hand to it. Hits the wrist instead of the palm.
goes down the track and drives it to long-off.
short from Christian and that has been pulled away rather easily to the deep square-leg region for a boundary. It is slipping away for the Chargers.
and he plays it away to the leg-side for a single now. This is easy now.
pitched up and drilled over the long-off fielder, that could have well been caught had the fielder been up to the fence!
yep, he is pitching them right up to the bat but it could well be a matter of too little, too late. Driven to wide long-off for a couple of easy runs.
again, pitched right up and KP only needs to play it away to the off-side for a single.
pitched right up and this time he drills it to the mid-off fielder for a single.
short and what a shot! He is bowling it short and wide and this time Nagar flashes hard at it and gets the placement right, through point!
drilled through to the long-off region for a single.
short and wide and Pietersen had smashed that over widish long-off for a flat six. Lot of pressure on the debutant now.
cut away and for a four! That is a superb stroke after the first five balls had cost him only two runs.
played away to the long-off fielder for a single
not pitching up again to KP, who flicks it away to mid-wicket.
a similar delivery and this time he finally gets his cut going to the third-man fielder.
on the length yet again and this time he tries to cut it away, misses the edge en route the wicket-keeper!
on the length and played away to the off-side.
walks down the track and hits it back to the bowler, who fumbles to hold it before throwing it back at the batsman. A few smiles and a few words later, Steyn takes his cap from the umpire.
defended on the front-foot and they are off for a quick single.
gone, caught! Steyn has taken his second wicket off a short ball, takes the glove and a simple catch for Patel behind the stumps, this should add spice to the proceedings
on the middle stump and Pathan defends it to the off-side. Yet to get a good spanking shot off the middle of the bat so far.
short and KP attempts a pull, hits hard into the ground, and gets a single to long-on.
slower one, and defended away on to the off-side.
short and cut away for a single. 45 needed off 36, which isn't too difficult unless the Chargers can get KP out.
goes down the track and that, I swear, has disappeared. Harsha Bhogale says it is on a metro going to CP in Delhi. I won't be surprised it that actually happened there!
played away to the leg-side, down to fine-leg for a single.
on the off-stump and played away to the leg-side.
spinning away, played away late to short third-man for a single.
Defended on the back-foot.
dropped! Full-toss and KP drills it back to the bowler, who spills it! It was coming a ridiculous pace alright, but JPD should have caught it! Umpire Billy Bowden was down on the ground too!
three in three and KP has turned it on big time. This was pitched right up to the batsman, not a full-toss but right in the slot and he tees off over the sightscreen!
another one, another six! This is a very poor couple of balls, tried to get it into he block-hole probably, and KP has dispatched it over mid-wicket for a six!
full-toss and Six! That wasn't the best delivery that you can bowl to a man in form and KP did not miss out, goes over long-on for a six!
down the leg-side and Pathan plays it away to the short fine-leg fielder for a single.
from around the stumps, KP drives it to the long-off fielder for a single. Fifty for KP, a very confident-looking innings from a man in form.
driven to long-off for a single
very full from the bowler and KP has driven it through extra-cover for a boundary! That was very easily done.
short and KP tries to smack it, but it goes more into the ground than anywhere else.
this time he is able to dab Ankit Sharma away to the fine-leg for a single
down the leg-side and Pathan goes for and misses the sweep. Wide called.
played away to the leg-side to the mid-wicket fielder.
pitched right up and KP drives it to long-off for a single
Pathan, in contrast, stays on the back-foot and tries to whip a length ball away, gets an inside-edge and it rolls away to the wicket-keeper.
goes down to the pitch yet again and this time it is drilled away to the leg-side for a single
goes down the track but can only drill it back to the bowler.
full-toss on the pads and KP drives it through to deep mid-wicket, and they are off for a couple.
pitched up on the leg-side and turned away for a single
short of length and punched to short cover.
outside the off-stump and driven on the up by KP, was to the left of the mid-off fielder, who had to dive but it went in vain and the ball sneaks through for a four. Moves on to 40 with that four.
outside the off-stump and driven on the up for a single. They had a slip in place for Pathan.
short and that goes way above Pathan's head, wide called.

pitched up a little, fdabbed away to the off-side and there is a run-out appeal here! Yep, Shikhar Dhawan has run Taylor out there, KP and Taylor went off for a quick run and the direct hit found the batsman short.
shortish yet again and Taylor goes on to the back-foot, taps it to the off-side and runs away for a single
on the middle and defended well by Taylor, the bowler fields off his own bowling.
short of length and deftly played to third-man for a single.
another one dropped a little short and this time it is banged to long-off for a run.
slower and shorter yet again, KP tries to unleash the cut but goes straight to the short cover fielder.
goes down the track, Ankit Sharma slows it down and beats KP in the flight.
drifting down the leg-side and KP tries to go down the leg-side
driven back to the bowler, who fields
on the middle-stump and he nudges it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple...oh wait, that is misfielded and the batsmen have enough time to come back for the third.
tries to cut it away but falls short of the short third-man fielder. 17 runs off the over and Deccan have a bit of an issue here...
down the leg-side and it is called a wide
short and KP has smacked it inside-out for a six! That was an incredible shot, the kind of power he got from it was something to watch
googly and beaten! Was outside the off-stump and Pietersen wanted to go over the leg-side, but he is beaten.
and he has now gone down the track and smacked Mishra into the stands for a six! What a stroke to bring up the side's half-century
a little short, a little wide and KP drills it through the covers for a four
wow! Turned a little and Pietersen wanted to drive it aggressively, misses the bat but more vitally the stumps as well!
this time Taylor hits it forcefully through the leg-side and the batsmen are back for an easy second.
slower this time and Taylor dabs it to the leg-side
varies his length, pitched up, played away to the long-on for a single
shortens his length and KP plays it back to the bowler
outside the off-stump and Pietersen goes down the track and smacks it to the left of the bowler for a four
on the pads from around the wicket, and driven away to deep square-leg for a single.
short of length, outside the off-stump, bit of a nip away from the bat and that is played away to the third-man fielder for a single.
and another one, short and pushing the batsman on to the back-foot, defended back to the bowler.
he continues to bowl them short and this time Pietersen confidently punches it back, the mid-on fielder had to put in the dive there.
short of good length and cut it away, goes only up to the third-man fielder for a single.
short and cut away but straight to the point fielder.
short and it is pulled away by Taylor through the on-side for a four! That was the first ball he was facing too!
on the middle and it is played away to the leg-side.
slower one and dabbed away to the off-side, wanted to go for a quick single but does not take the risk.
misfielded and four! That has been drilled through the covers for a four by KP. That was short of length and punched on the up and it is that man Chipli yet again!

gone, caught! Shimmies down the track and wants to go over the in-field on the off-side but the ball seems to have hit high on the bat and it loops up easily for Jayawardene's Sri Lankan teammate, Sanga to take at wide mid-off.
walks to the off-side, flicks it to the leg-side and they are off for a single.
down the leg-side and it is called a wide. Slower one, bowled at 118 km/hr.
tapped away to the off-side for a single.
146.7 km/hr, yorker and defended away by Pietersen to the leg-side. End of a fiery over from Steyn, will he bowl another in his spell?
144.5 km/hr, outside the off-stump and edged away to third-man for a single.
146.5 km/hr, full, on the pads of Jayawardene and he has only pushed it over the leg-side, Steyn's pace gets him a four over mid-wicket.
pitched right up this time after two shortish balls and Jayawardene coolly defends it.

147.4 km/hr, gone this time, caught! Sehwag has edged it to the second slip to Christian and Delhi are two down! That was a quick ball, touching 150 km/hr almost and Sehwag only managed to get an edge to the ball, the slip had only just been brought in.
148.3 km/hr, dropped! Short from Steyn and KP attempts a pull, goes to Chipli at short mid-wicket and it is floored!
and this time it is whipped away to the leg-side for a couple of runs. It was pitched right up to the bat and the fine-leg was up in the circle.
slammed over the bowler and the umpire for a four! Pitched right up and Sehwag was almost hanging on his back-foot and smacked it away...
outside the off-stump and KP is confident enough to get outside the off and play it to mid-on for a single
fullish ball, pitched right up and Pietersen drives it back to the bowler.
goes down the track yet again and tries to force it away through the leg-side, the fielder at the short mid-wicket needed to dive on to his right to stop the ball.
outside the off-stump and Pietersen is on the front-foot, driven back to the bowler
again, does not pitch it up to the batsman, played away on the back-foot to the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
outside the off-stump, probably going away from the batsman and tapped away to the point region. KP wants to get going quickly, such is his form I think.
on the middle, short of length and KP defends away to the leg-side.
and what a superb stroke! Goes down the pitch, shimmies to off-stump and flicked away through the mid-wicket region for a four.
peach! That was pitched on the middle and most part of its path it looked like it would come in, then it pitched and decided to deviate away from the batsman, beats him!
short of length and KP punches it off the back-foot to covers.
short of length, coming into the batsman and he plays it to the off-side. A very good first over from the debutant.

pitched up and Ojha goes for a drive over the off-side, he gets a lot of height on that shot and not too much distance, JP Duminy who was only moments earlier miked up and speaking to the commentators, takes a good catch.
on the off-stump, moving a tad away from the bat and the batsman defends yet again.
on his pads and Sehwag has flicked it away to square-leg for a single
pitched up, a bit of movement away from the bat and he drives it through the covers for a single.
on the middle, short of length and the batsman defends on the back-foot.
